facts.fact: IFC (World Bank Group, Washington-based) signed on 2025-12-10 a sustainability-linked loan of about $10.4 million equivalent in rand to OADC PropCo South Africa, WIOCC's data-centre property subsidiary, part of a wider $70 million IFC package (the $50 million equity and the $10 million tranche are not tied to ZAF).
facts.system: IFC WIOCC VI Debt (project 51154), South Africa tranche

note: Only the rand tranche to OADC PropCo South Africa carries an ZAF-specific amount; the rest of the package and the $577 million plan are multi-country.
